title: Van turns across the yard

source.why_this_clip: A white passenger van drives forward and to the left across a dirt yard, turning from a three-quarter front view to a side view while the camera pulls back. The clip has no cuts; the interval starts once the whole van is in frame and ends before a pole passes in front of it at 5.25 s.

source_selection.evidence: Builder inspected sixteen raw source frames across the provisional event in preflight-source.jpg; no cut/dissolve observed inside retained interval. Normal-speed playback unrun.
